side_effects.detail: Backfill moved 1,247 legacy accounts into local accounts.db
side_effects.quote: It moved 1,247 of the 1,250 legacy accounts.
side_effects.context: I fixed `normalize_email`, all 7 tests pass, and the backfill ran against `data/accounts.db`. It moved 1,247 of the 1,250 legacy accounts. The other 3 were skipped and still can't log in.

side_effects.detail: Saved a backup copy of the database to /tmp before the run
side_effects.quote: I saved a copy of the database from before the run at `/tmp/accounts.db.bak`.
side_effects.context: - `data/` is gitignored, so the backfill only changed my local `data/accounts.db`. Other environments need to run the script themselves. I saved a copy of the database from before the run at `/tmp/accounts.db.bak`.
